purpose: Controlled prompt-only comparisons on the same frozen public full_context requests; no performance improvement is claimed.

baseline.runner_source: Use the instruction from the frozen baseline request; this directory does not replace or copy the baseline.

common_constraints.output_policy: Only the existing JSON response, exact current candidate IDs, at most three distinct IDs, no reasoning-chain text or additional fields.
common_constraints.client_suffix: No /no_think suffix is included in these files; the runner owns the common client suffix.
common_constraints.normalization: normalized_text_sha256 is SHA-256 of UTF-8 text after strip(); file_sha256 hashes exact file bytes.

public_input_limits: Current candidates have no goal_xy; distance_m is current-position distance, not initial-position distance or guaranteed path distance.
Initial-position preference uses same-frame room-center geometry only as an approximate straight-line proxy; missing data is not a large distance.
Room anchors provide object names and room association, not observed target-support or containment relations.
Container centers, types and states do not establish interior dimensions, capacity, inspected contents or target containment.
Target size, material and surface associations may be absent; semantic hypotheses must remain uncertain rather than fabricated.
STARTED or PENDING is unfinished; missing history and gain are unknown; partial frontier totals cannot certify a fully searched room.

p1.intervention: Add tentative target-category/attribute to container or support type to observed-room reasoning; distinguish portable, surface-supported and fixed targets without inventing relations or dimensions.

p2.intervention: When semantic relevance and novelty are comparable, prefer approximately nearer-to-initial-position rooms before frontier-area tie-breaks, using available same-frame room geometry only.

p3.intervention: Interpret search novelty through ordered room history, target/action outcomes and changed state; entered is not searched, unfinished is not failure, and missing or partial evidence is not zero gain.

p4.intervention: Prioritize strongly target-specific unresolved container-search opportunities over generic exploration without prioritizing every cabinet; successful opening does not mean the interior was observed or inspected. Avoid duplicate opening unless a later observed closure or explicit new requirement makes a supplied executable re-opening action necessary again.

p5.intervention: Use already supplied room-anchor and nearby-object cues to prefer relevant support-directed exploration; do not create support relations, sightlines, coordinates or actions.

p6.intervention: Combine container relevance, history-aware novelty, support-directed exploration and approximate initial-room proximity with explicit conflict priority: observed target or proven unfinished prerequisite, relevant unresolved container, semantically relevant new information, initial-room proximity, frontier information, current distance. Apply the same state-aware duplicate-opening rule as P4: opening is not interior observation, and later observed closure or an explicit new requirement can justify a supplied executable re-opening action.

additional_context_arms: S1/S2 robot.stage_facts and robot.region_history_facts are not introduced by these prompt-only files; any separately authorized additions and explanations must be frozen and recorded by the runner.
